fusions.name: Sluggish Sting
fusions.desc: Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back. A strike that deals 7 damage, slows the target by 25% for 3 seconds and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Noonday Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a spore at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It leaves the target [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Stillness
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You regain 15 health.

fusions.name: Sunfed Cap
fusions.desc: In daylight, your damage rises by 12%. You regenerate 0.5 health a second.
